titulo: A rolled towel across the gap
caption:
A rolled towel across the gap

A thin stream of cold ran along the floor from under the door. A rolled towel went across the gap and the stream stopped.

A rolled towel at the foot of the door costs nothing and keeps the hallway draft out all winter.

For whoever rolls a towel against the gap under the door.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A hallway with a closed cream door on the right and a rolled terracotta towel with a dark band lying on the floor in the middle. Pale blue streaks of cold air blow left along the floor from under the door. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the towel hops in an arc to the foot of the door and lands across the gap. The streaks vanish and a small sparkle lights above. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me, rolling it against the draft.
